Here are the **keywords** extracted from the job description for the **Senior Technical Program Manager** role at **CVS Health Digital**:

### **Core Role & Responsibilities:**
- Senior Technical Program Manager
- Technical Program Management
- Cross-functional engineering teams
- Enterprise initiatives
- Digital products
- Software engineering program management
- Stakeholder management
- Risk mitigation
- Issue resolution
- Full-cycle program delivery
- Prioritization
- Leadership
- Front-end design & technologies
- Consumer-obsessed
- Process improvements
- Engineering practice

### **Required Skills & Experience:**
- IT/Digital experience
- Enterprise-class applications
- TPM (Technical Program Manager / Product/Project/Program Manager)
- Large-scale software engineering programs
- Agile/Scrum (implied by "fast-paced environment")
- Stakeholder communication
- Delivery track record
- Highly motivated
- Collaborative
- Results-driven

### **Industry & Domain-Specific:**
- Healthcare digital products
- CVS Health
- Digital transformation
- Health tech

These keywords can be used for **resume optimization, ATS (Applicant Tracking System) alignment, and LinkedIn profile updates** to improve visibility for this role. Would you like any refinements based on a specific focus (e.g., leadership vs. technical skills)?
